text:
alex: :rotating_light: Observed a sustained 95p latency spike on eu-dedicated pool starting ~1942003400. 95p up from ~120ms -> ~900ms, throughput dropped ~35%. Autoscale did not add slots.

maria: seeing same. multiple tenants affected, not just one noisy tenant. graphs look like sudden drop in batch packing efficiency + KV eviction spike.

ryan: quick check: kernel-selection logs show fallback to slower kernel on several nodes around 1942003420. might be a regression from the last runtime rollout.

alex: adding logs excerpt: ```
[2026-03-09T02:03:45Z] node=eu-gpu-12 kernel=fast_attention status=OK
[2026-03-09T02:03:50Z] node=eu-gpu-12 kernel=fast_attention status=DEGRADED reason=eviction_pressure
[2026-03-09T02:03:55Z] node=eu-gpu-12 kernel=generic_attention status=FALLBACK
```

jess: eviction_pressure? which cache? prefix-KV or shard-local object cache?

maria: prefix-KV eviction rate jumped from <1% to ~27% at spike start. eviction_rate metric attached to node exporter.

infra-bot: Incident autoscale-check: no scaling event triggered between 1942003400 and 1942005200 due to quota_limit=reserved_slots incorrectly set to 0 for eu-reserved-config. Retrieved config: `reserved_slots=0` (expected >= 20).

samir: whoa — reserved_slots=0 explains autoscale not kicking in for dedicated. That looks like a config propagation bug in the placement service after last deploy.

ryan: correlation: fallback to generic kernel increases per-token compute, which increases KV cache miss rate because KV working set expanded. More misses -> more GPU memory churn -> eviction -> kernel fallback -> repeat. vicious cycle.

alex: confirmed noisy neighbor behavior: three tenants had high long-context requests concurrently and pushed batch packing to degrade. With reserved_slots=0 we couldn't spin up extra hosts to isolate them.

jess: replication of failure on canary: ran stress profile with two long-seq tenants + default request mix, saw the same pattern. Quick profiling output: ```
batch_pack_efficiency: 0.42 -> 0.18
kv_miss_rate: 0.06 -> 0.28
kernel_time_fast: 35ms -> 110ms
```

maria: immediate mitigation options? temp actions: 1) revert placement-config rollout, 2) bump reserved_slots via console, 3) increase KV cache size (if possible) on affected nodes.

ryan: recommend bump reserved_slots to 30 for eu pool and enforce placement-service invariant check. Doing that now.

sre-oncall: going to add emergency quota override and scale to target. Notifying customers on affected SLAs.

alex: did the override. reserved_slots=30 applied at 1942003850, new nodes started joining at 1942003955. latency improved but didn't fully return to baseline until eviction_rate subsided (~20m).

maria: post-mitigation metrics: 95p down to ~180ms, batch_pack_efficiency recovered to 0.38, kv_miss_rate back to ~0.07.

jess: root cause hypothesis: a placement-service rollout introduced a default reserved_slots=0 when config source missing. Combined with a workload change (more long-context traffic) triggered KV thrash + kernel fallback regression.

samir: next steps: 1) revert/aggressively patch placement-service to enforce reserved_slots floor, 2) add unit test + e2e to catch reserved_slots default, 3) add runtime guard to prefer fast kernel when eviction rates are transient, 4) update canary criteria to include batch_pack_efficiency and kv_miss_rate thresholds.

alex: logging action items in incident tracker and scheduling postmortem. Also flagging runtime team to audit last kernel-selection change for fallback heuristics.

maria: quick note for postmortem — capture timeline with config commits (placement-service), runtime rollout id, and tenant traffic spikes. We'll need heap snapshots from affected nodes to analyze eviction churn.

ryan: I'll produce a flamegraph and kernel decision trace for the affected nodes. jess + infra, please collect KV cache histograms.

sre-oncall: communications: incident declared sev-2, customer-facing note drafted. Will update once we have RCA.

alex: thanks all — good catch on reserved_slots. lessons: config propagation + safe defaults are critical; also add more signals to canary to avoid this feedback loop. :thumbsup:

maria: closing loop after postmortem.

infra-bot: Deployment note: placement-service rollout 2026-03-09T01:58Z (rev: ps-1.9.4) had config change path `defaults.reserved_slots` — investigation flagged missing default guard.

samir: assigning owners: placement-service (maria), runtime kernel (ryan), autoscaler (jess). I'll schedule a cross-team sync tomorrow.

alex: end of thread.
